product: PDRN Pink Collagen Toning Gel Toner Pad

reviews.headline: Sticky and causes breakouts
reviews.comment: Even on freshly washed skin, one swipe of this will leave your skin sticky. Even after waiting two hours for it to soak in, it never did. The next morning I had signs of breakouts starting (itchy patches, redness, clogged pore). Sensitive skin beware.

reviews.headline: It's ok
reviews.comment: This is just ok. The directions say to leave the pad on your skin for 5 minutes. The pink solution drips down your face and not to mention you have to use 2 pads per time.  It doesn't give my skin the glass look like the other Medicube pads. I'll be returning them.

reviews.headline: Love this product
reviews.comment: I first bought the bundle set medicube  offered on tik tock. It had so many items in it. The entire pdrn line came with it as well as several other products. I'm so glad Ulta offers medicube now. I can get all my products in one store now.  Being a working  makeup artist  I've tried many products out there. I tell all my clients Your skin is your foundation.  If you don't have good skin care, it won't matter what expensive makeup line you use. It's not going to look as good as it should if you don't take care of your skin.  I'm over 45 now.  So with age we really need to step up our skin care game. Medicube products definitely delivers the results. It's become  my go to to recommend for clients. I noticed just after a few uses my skin looks more plump, The texture of my skin has improved. It's so much smoother and It gives my skin a more youthful glow and appearance. I'll use these  pads right  after I use the toner and pdrn petide serum. When you receive this product.   The liquid comes in a  separate sealed pouch. You need to pour all of the liquid in the container with the pads. As with any container make sure the lid is screwed on tightly.  Once you have the lid on, the  top part if the lid flips open. It comes with plastic tweezers. There's a  place for them  to snap into the lid. So you can keep it sanitary. The lid does snap shut tightly too. I've never had a problem with any liquid leaking out. Medicube has  products for every skin type. I highly recommend

reviews.headline: Awesome for hydration!
reviews.comment: These are great to add moisture and hydration withiut a lot of fuss or leftover residue. I notice a bug boost in hydration after using them. I recommnd cutting the pads in half prior to adding the liquid and placing them on cheeks and forehead.

reviews.headline: Best thing ever!
reviews.comment: Cleared my skin up completely will never stop using!
